econ-econ-01-c3.text: Merlise Clyde (2019). Identifiability and Gauss-Markov. STA 721 course notes, Duke University.
econ-econ-01-c3.quote: establishes that out of the class of all linear unbiased estimators that the OLS estimator has minimum variance.
econ-econ-01-c3.claim: Under 1–5, OLS is BLUE, the Best Linear Unbiased Estimator (lowest variance among unbiased linear estimators).
